public.heroDesc: Access over 300+ government services seamlessly. A unified platform designed to bring administration closer to you.
public.whyDesc: Streamline your regulatory journey with our intelligent platform designed for speed, transparency, and accuracy.
public.feature1Desc: Tailored step-by-step guidance automatically derived from your industry, location, and operational scale.
public.feature2Desc: Centralized repository with expiry tracking, automated validation, and reusable certificate management.
public.feature3Desc: Transparent multi-stage progress tracking with instant alerts on officer review milestones.
public.feature4Desc: Instant answers from official Maharashtra state regulatory guidelines and gazette notifications.
public.step1Desc: Register your business entity with basic industry and location details.
public.step2Desc: System rules engine generates the exact list of required licences and clearances.
public.step3Desc: Upload once and verify necessary compliance certificates in the secure vault.
public.step4Desc: Submit single-window forms directly routed to designated department officers.
public.step5Desc: Track status in real-time, respond to corrections, and download approved certificates.
